description:
Update an existing invoice in Well.

Call well_get_schema("invoices") to discover all available fields.

REQUIRED: invoice_id
OPTIONAL (only pass fields you want changed):
  - reference_number, issue_date (ISO date), due_date (ISO date)
  - status (draft | issued | paid | canceled)
  - terms, description
  - grand_total, items_total, tax_total (numbers)
  - local_currency (ISO 4217 three-letter code, e.g. "EUR", "USD")
  - document_type_code (UN/CEFACT 1001 code, e.g. "380")
  - billing_context (e.g. subscription, one_time, project, ...)
  - issuer_company_id / receiver_company_id (uuid to set, null to clear,
    omit to leave unchanged)

Cannot change line items, payment_means, or document attachment via this tool.

billing_context.description: Billing context / business model; pass null to clear

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

description.description: Free-form description; pass null to clear

document_type_code.description: UN/CEFACT 1001 document type code (e.g. 380 for commercial invoice); pass null to clear

due_date.description: Payment due date (ISO 8601); pass null to clear

grand_total.description: Total invoice amount including tax; pass null to clear

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A retried write with the same key returns the original result instead of re-applying the operation.

invoice_id.description: The UUID of the invoice to update

issue_date.description: Issue date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-04-27); pass null to clear

issuer_company_id.description: Issuer company UUID. Omit = no change, null = clear, uuid = set.

items_total.description: Sum of line items before tax; pass null to clear

local_currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g. EUR, USD); pass null to clear

override_version.description: Required when payment_status is present — current override_version for CAS

receiver_company_id.description: Receiver company UUID. Omit = no change, null = clear, uuid = set.

reference_number.description: Invoice reference number (e.g. INV-2026-001); pass null to clear

tax_total.description: Total tax amount; pass null to clear

terms.description: Payment terms text; pass null to clear

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several — a write lands in exactly one workspace and this call would not say which.

name: well_update_invoice

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.
